nodes.label: Arachne
nodes.author: Amsy
nodes.rationale: Blender add-on packaging procedural web generation, GPU physics, and silk rendering into one sidebar panel; requires Blender 5.2 LTS minimum. MIT licensed.

nodes.label: Orb Web Generator
nodes.rationale: Classic radial/spiral web; scalloped sag, uneven spiral spacing, damage gaps, asymmetry, wavy radials and tangle threads are deliberately added because perfectly regular geometry reads as synthetic — the irregularity sells a naturally aged web.

nodes.label: Chaotic Cobweb Generator
nodes.rationale: Simulated spiders spin threads between scene surfaces rather than fitting a parametric shape, so the web conforms to arbitrary corner/prop/room geometry. Construction adapted from Pixar's Toy Story 4 cobweb talk.

nodes.label: Clumping
nodes.rationale: Draws spiders toward a few random attractor spots so dense knots alternate with sparser spans, reproducing the uneven density of real webs instead of uniform coverage.

nodes.label: Bridge Bias
nodes.rationale: Single 0-1 knob for how much anchors commit to spanning gaps: 0 = local webbing hugging each surface, 1 = long cables between separate/floating geometry. Collapses a topology choice into one artist-facing slider.

nodes.label: Spread
nodes.rationale: Controls how uniformly spiders fill the volume: 0 = dense local clumps, 1 = Pixar-style even coverage. Recommended dense reference look is 1200 Spin Steps with Spread 0.9.

nodes.label: Live Update
nodes.rationale: Rebuilds the web instantly on any parameter change so the look can be dialed in realtime before the (expensive) solver and strand stages are added.

nodes.label: GPU Physics Solver
nodes.rationale: Built on Blender's native GPU module specifically so the add-on ships with zero external dependencies.

nodes.label: Verlet / PBD Solver with Tearing
nodes.rationale: Position-based dynamics with a tear threshold: threads snap when overstretched.

nodes.label: Silk-like Unilateral Constraints
nodes.rationale: Constraints only resist stretching, never compression — real silk pulls but cannot push, so a bilateral distance constraint would make slack threads springy and wrong.

nodes.label: Tension Control
nodes.rationale: Selects between taut webs and drooping catenaries; ~0.95 for taut structural webs, ~0.5 for droopy abandoned ones. Pair low tension with Deteriorate for an aged look.

nodes.label: World-space Gravity and Wind with Turbulence
nodes.norm_label: world-space gravity and wind with turbulence

nodes.label: Collision (Bounding Sphere / SDF)
nodes.rationale: Two tiers: bounding sphere for speed, baked SDF for accuracy. A collision collection merges all member meshes into one field so many colliders cost one lookup. SDF needs a closed mesh with outward normals; animated collider location is supported but rotation is frozen at bake, and deforming meshes fall back to the bounded shape.

nodes.label: SDF Resolution
nodes.rationale: Raise it for thin or detailed colliders — the baked field otherwise misses geometry smaller than a voxel.

nodes.label: Stickiness
nodes.rationale: A tunable fraction of contacting points latch to the collider surface so the web drapes and clings instead of sliding off — pure collision response alone would let the web slip away.

nodes.label: Deteriorate and Pre-warm
nodes.rationale: Deteriorate pre-breaks threads for an aged look; pre-warm starts the sim already settled so frame 1 is usable without waiting for the web to relax.

nodes.label: Substeps
nodes.rationale: Raise when a fast collider tunnels through the web without tearing — the discrete timestep steps past the threads between iterations.

nodes.label: Render-safe Frame Cache
nodes.rationale: GPU compute cannot run on Blender's render thread, so every frame simulated in the viewport is cached and replayed during F12/animation renders. The user must play through the range once to 'bake'.

nodes.label: Anchor Pinning (Pin / Unpin)
nodes.rationale: Anchor points are pinned automatically; overridden by selecting vertices in Edit Mode and using Pin / Unpin.

nodes.label: Strandify
nodes.rationale: Converts the simulated web into smooth silk tubes using Catmull-Rom smoothing with a noisy radius, so the coarse simulation mesh does not need to be dense to render as fine silk.

nodes.label: Dew Droplets with Physics
nodes.rationale: Droplets cling to strands, condense and grow, slide down to hang under the silk, then drip off and free-fall once heavy enough, respawning at their birth spot for a perpetual drip cycle. Droplets on torn strands are flung off.

nodes.label: Bake Dew for Render
nodes.rationale: The render depsgraph cannot reuse the viewport's live simulation, so the bake stores droplet motion to disk and simultaneously fills the web solver's render cache.

nodes.label: Tension Heatmap Material
nodes.rationale: Visualizes stretch from blue (rest) to red (about to tear); enabled via Show Tension on the Strandify modifier so the Tear Threshold can be tuned by eye.

nodes.label: Create Web + Sim + Strands
nodes.rationale: One-button quick-start operator that chains generation, solver setup and strand conversion; optional collider/anchor mesh is selected first.

nodes.label: No Thread Self-Collision
nodes.rationale: Self-collision between threads is deliberately not simulated — the broad-phase cost on a dense web would not pay for itself visually.

nodes.label: Command-line / Farm Render Limitation
nodes.rationale: The GPU solver only runs during viewport playback and UI renders, so headless/farm rendering requires playing the shot through once and exporting the animated web (e.g. Alembic) first.
